prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ONLY_CWT_catboost', seasonality_champion='catboost', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: ONLY_CWT_catboost achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) but poor RMSE (4305), while catboost best captures seasonality (0.56) with strong overall performance (2238 RMSE). DWT_rf dominates overall (1867 RMSE) and excels at late horizons (1497). With rmse_spread_ratio=36.34, unstable rankings (Kendall τ=0.26), and high model disagreement, robust median/trimmed_mean combinations are preferred over stacking to avoid overfitting noise.
